news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹17.45 (vs ₹10.58 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹17.45 (up from ₹10.58 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹8.92b (up 15% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹276.8m (up 65% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 3.1% (up from 2.2% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 20% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 12% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹4.71 (vs ₹2.25 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.71 (up from ₹2.25 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹2.50b (up 26% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹74.7m (up 109% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.0% (up from 1.8% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 22% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 12% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
